title: 最好的扑克手牌
summary: 五张牌给出点数与花色，按同花、三条、对子、高牌的优先级返回最好牌型。
insight: 先判断五个花色是否全相同；否则统计点数最高频次，频次至少三为三条、至少二为对子，其余高牌。
pitfalls: 同花优先级最高，应先判断
四个相同点数也归入三条类别
返回字符串需与题目指定名称一致

solutions.title: 先同花后点数频次
solutions.idea: 按优先级从高到低判定。
steps: 检查 suits 是否全等，是则 Flush
统计 ranks 频次并求 maximum
maximum>=3 返回 Three of a Kind；>=2 返回 Pair

code.java: class Solution { public String bestHand(int[] ranks,char[] suits){boolean flush=true;for(char suit:suits)flush&=suit==suits[0];if(flush)return "Flush";int[] frequency=new int[14];int maximum=0;for(int rank:ranks)maximum=Math.max(maximum,++frequency[rank]);if(maximum>=3)return "Three of a Kind";if(maximum>=2)return "Pair";return "High Card";} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun bestHand(ranks:IntArray,suits:CharArray):String{if(suits.all{it==suits[0]})return "Flush";val frequency=IntArray(14);var maximum=0;for(rank in ranks)maximum=maxOf(maximum,++frequency[rank]);return when{maximum>=3->"Three of a Kind";maximum>=2->"Pair";else->"High Card"}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:string bestHand(vector<int>& ranks,vector<char>& suits){if(all_of(suits.begin(),suits.end(),[&](char suit){return suit==suits[0];}))return "Flush";int frequency[14]={},maximum=0;for(int rank:ranks)maximum=max(maximum,++frequency[rank]);if(maximum>=3)return "Three of a Kind";if(maximum>=2)return "Pair";return "High Card";} };
